BJP Leader Criticizes Dhirendra Shastri Over Food Habits Remark

West Bengal BJP President Sukanta Majumdar criticized Dhirendra Shastri, a religious leader, for his remarks on Durga Puja food habits. Majumdar stated that an outsider cannot dictate the food traditions of Bengalis, particularly concerning their dietary choices during the festival. The statement came in response to Shastri's reported comments suggesting that Bengalis should abstain from non-vegetarian food during Durga Puja.
